mapper.select: SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID prodId, fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID mProdId, to_char(calc.EFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') feeEffectDate, calc.YIELD commissionRate, fee.FEE_NAME feeName, fee.FEE_TYPE feeType, to_char(fin.MDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') feeInvalidDate, fee.CHARGE_TYPE chargeMode FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, FIN_CASH_INFO info, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE calc, MST_FEEINFO fee WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = '${finProdId}' AND fin.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_ID AND info.CASH_TYPE_1 = '${cashType1}' AND info.CASH_ID = calc.CASH_ID AND info.FEE_ID = calc.FEE_ID
